messages:
Aria (growth): Quick triage for Monday KPI deck — APAC launch posts + webinar pushed sessions up in APAC but MQLs barely moved. Can we reconcile attribution, timezone bucketing, and form timing before the review? :wave:
Ben (analytics): Noted. Early checks: APAC sessions +40% WoW, leads +7%, MQLs +2. Two likely drivers: partner tracking redirects in APAC that strip utm params, and our dashboard day bucket configured to UTC which slices APAC evenings into different days.
Kofi: Also reminder we A/B'd the post creative and accidentally reused utm_campaign=apac_launch for both variants. That hides per-creative funnel performance.
Aria (growth): Oof. Okay action plan: Ben reconcile utm/referrer + creative_id mapping; Kofi validate creative naming and provide creative_id->copy mapping; OpsBot annotate the KPI board for timezone + partner redirect. Target: Monday 08:30 PT.
Ben (analytics): Running a small reproducible query; paste for reuse:
```
SELECT date_trunc('day', occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS utc_day,
       date_trunc('day', occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Singapore') AS sg_day,
       coalesce(utm_source,'(none)') AS utm_source,
       landing_template,
       COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS sessions,
       SUM(is_lead::int) AS leads,
       SUM(is_mql::int) AS mqls
FROM page_events
WHERE occurred_at >= '2026-07-01' AND occurred_at < '2026-07-08'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY sg_day DESC, sessions DESC;
```
Kofi: I'll export creative_id mapping and confirm which ads reused the campaign tag. Also checking if partner redirect domains have a recommended passthrough param.
MetricsBot: Quick summary: APAC sessions +38% WoW, partner_redirect domains = 17% sessions, partner_redirect utm_missing = 86% of that subset. Short-form landing (compact) median time-to-MQL = 12 days, hero-long median = 3 days.
Aria (growth): Good context. Ben please include first-touch vs last-touch columns in the CSV; we want to show how attribution model shifts credit between webinar and posts.
Ben (analytics): Will include first_touch, last_touch, reg_date, mql_date, landing_template, creative_id. CSV goal by Monday 07:45 PT.
OpsBot: Annotation created on kpi-weekly: "2026-07-06 APAC launch: partner redirects stripped UTM params; dashboard day-bucketing UTC vs SG may affect week comparisons. See analytics CSV for reconciled attribution."
Kofi: One quick ask for the KPI narrative: can we call out that APAC webinar regs convert at ~20% but require longer nurture; short-form social drives sessions but low immediate MQL. I'll draft a 2-sentence benchmark paragraph once I see the CSV.
Aria (growth): Perfect. Final: Ben + Kofi + OpsBot if we can close by Monday 08:30 PT we'll slot the reconciled numbers and the short blurb into the KPI deck. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly. :thumbsup:
